overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today in the Montrose (High Elevation) FDRA, driven by low humidity (30%) and dry fuels, with none of the 7 local watchout thresholds currently met.**
- Danger holds Moderate through Saturday before easing to Low Sunday through Tuesday as moisture moves in.
- A cold front brings scattered precipitation (up to 0.06") and cooler highs (upper 30s–40s) starting Friday, trimming energy release component from the low 50s% to near 37–41%.
- Winds stay light today (6 mph, N), with calm, sunny weather continuing through Veterans Day and Thursday; no Red Flag Warning or NWS alerts are in effect.
- No active fire restrictions are reported for Montrose-area counties at this time; conditions should be verified locally before burning.
- No wildfires are currently active in or near the Montrose, Gunnison, Delta, Ouray, San Miguel, or surrounding counties.
